semantics.state_output: Moore machine: OFF has out=0, ON has out=1; out reflects current registered state without extra latency.
semantics.transition: At a rising clock edge, OFF goes to ON iff j=1, while ON goes to OFF iff k=1. k is irrelevant in OFF and j is irrelevant in ON, as shown by the original diagram.
semantics.reset: Original specifies active-high synchronous reset to OFF; reset overrides transitions at the sampling clock edge and has no asynchronous effect.
semantics.initialization: Original supplies no power-up state; no declaration initialization is added and functional checks start with a sampled reset.
semantics.clock: Use rising-edge sampling, the conventional interpretation of the original clocked synchronous machine; no clock edge is explicitly stated.

numeric.port_width: All ports are single-bit; no arithmetic or signed behavior.

verification.oracle: Independent expected state updated from the original OFF/ON transition diagram on each rising edge, with synchronous reset priority.
verification.coverage: All j/k combinations in each state, reset in both states with all input combinations, midcycle reset and input changes, repeated holds and toggles.
verification.sampling: Compare before each rising edge to verify state retention and after a delay to allow nonblocking assignment settlement.
verification.completion: Fatal on mismatch or bounded timeout; print PASS only after all checks complete.

specification_ambiguities: The original does not explicitly identify a clock edge; rising-edge operation is assumed.
Power-up state and behavior for unknown reset/j/k inputs are unspecified; no required initial known value or unknown-input transition behavior is imposed.
